name: Adriana Flores
title: Accounting & Bookkeeping Specialist
summary_base: Accounting and bookkeeping professional with 20+ years of experience supporting corporate and nonprofit organizations with accurate financial reporting, reconciliations, payroll, and grant accounting. Skilled in Microsoft Dynamics GP, QuickBooks Online, and Excel, with expertise in multi-entity accounting, month-end close, and financial operations. QBO Certified ProAdvisor and Xero Certified Advisor. Bilingual English/Spanish. Seeking remote accounting or bookkeeping roles.

experience.title: Accountant
bullets: Perform full-cycle accounting using Microsoft Dynamics GP including journal entries, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, vendor payments, and aging reports.
Allocate payroll expenses across multiple grants and funding sources ensuring compliance with grant requirements.
Prepare financial statements and support external audits and internal reporting.
Process vendor invoices with 100% on-time payment rate and resolve billing discrepancies.

experience.title: Accounting Clerk
bullets: Managed payroll processing for approximately 150 employees using Paylocity.
Prepared 1099 forms and resolved general ledger discrepancies.
Supported month-end close procedures and financial reporting.
Processed vendor invoices and maintained accounts payable with 100% on-time payment rate.

experience.title: Staff Accountant
bullets: Performed full-cycle bookkeeping including reconciliations, transaction coding, and monthly financial reporting.
Prepared and submitted grant and contract invoices; maintained accounts receivable aging reports.
Reconciled general ledger accounts and supported month-end close and financial statement preparation.
Allocated payroll expenses across multiple grant-funded programs.
